{{Rhere|Serpent|[[Serpent (disambiguation)|other uses of the word]]}}
[[File:GiantSerpent-ShinyAsADroid.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Unidentified giant serpent|giant serpent]]]]
{{Quote|Snakes, huh? They don't bother me!|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Yoda Stories">''[[Star Wars: Yoda Stories]]''</ref>}}
'''Snakes''', also known as '''slitherettes''', '''serpents''', or '''ophidians'''<ref name="CCG-VineLS">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Vine Snake (Light)}}</ref> were lengthy, [[Limb/Legends|limbless]] creatures. They moved about by coiling around limbs or side-winding across the ground. Some snakes were [[Poison/Legends|venomous]].<ref name="DO">''[[Domain of Evil]]''</ref>

At the [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Sith War)|Battle of Coruscant]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], [[Color/Legends|green]] serpents attacked the [[Republic command center]] ahead of [[Aleema Keto]] and [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma's]] advance.<ref name="TSW 2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 2]]</ref>

As a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] wore a [[Armor/Legends|shoulder piece]] that featured a black snake.<ref name="Bounty">{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}}</ref>
